label: rem:information-theoretic-time-arrow
title: The arrow of time inherited from the braiding order
html:
Remark. The arrow of time inherited from the braiding order

The information-theoretic time inherits its direction from the braiding order \prec_c. The arrow of time is not re-derived in the continuous limit.

Consistency with the arrow of time. The braiding-induced ordering \prec_c on the Hecke basis (ordering–jet compatibility) propagates through the jet tower. This defines forward and backward time at every brane level. We define the information-theoretic time \mathcal{T} as the counting measure on this well-ordering: \mathcal{T}(a) < \mathcal{T}(b) iff a \prec_c b. The rescaling t = \hbar_q \mathcal{T} preserves the order, ensuring the Reeb time coordinate inherits the same arrow.
